profile.headline: Software Engineer at NT Concepts
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer, I specialize in front-end development, focusing on creating user-friendly interfaces and staying updated on industry trends. With a passion for learning and problem-solving, I thrive in collaborative environments and aim to make meaningful contributions to projects. My goal is to continue growing alongside talented teams while delivering effective solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Collaborate in the maintenance and enhancement of two web applications utilizing Angular front end and Python Django backend technologies.
•	Drive accessibility initiatives by implementing improvements to ensure compliance with Section 508 accessibility standards, enhancing user experience for diverse audiences.
•	Develop and maintain automated test suites to ensure application reliability
•	Contribute to feature development, including designing, coding, testing, and deployment processes.
•	Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to enhance code quality and maintainability.
•	Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and stakeholders, to deliver high-quality solutions on time and within budget.
positions.insights: Software Design, Web Engineering and +7 skills

positions.description:

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.locationName: Tysons Corner, Virginia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Worked on the back end/API team for building an AI/ML research trends dashboard
• Used the Python REST API framework to generate endpoints and pass data to the front end
• Furthered experience with the Agile process and using Azure DevOps
• Gained experience with using Git Repositories and coding alongside several other developers
• Built a finished product and presented to the product owner and the entire company
